history.summary: 99-yr LH D03 1BR (452 sqft) at $998k / $2,208 psf, literally 30m from Redhill EW MRT, with a robust 137-transaction URA series — the most reliable data in this batch. Asking PSF ($2,208) sits right on the $2,214 median; sub-$1M shoebox quantum plus EWL-on-doorstep gives this strong rentability.
history.rating_rationale: 30m to Redhill MRT on the East-West Line is a premium rental driver, and 137 txns make the 3.48%/yr rate and $2,214 median highly reliable. Priced at the median with no premium, sub-$1M entry, and excellent connectivity in the GSW/TEL-adjacent D03 corridor. Caveat: 1BR is a narrow buyer pool and 3.48% appreciation is moderate, so this is a yield/rentability play more than a capital-growth one — but on data quality and location it earns a Buy.
red_flags: Moderate 3.48%/yr appreciation — yield play, not high growth
catalysts: 30m to Redhill EWL MRT — top-tier rental/exit driver
137-txn reliable data, priced at median (no premium)
D03 RCR near Greater Southern Waterfront and city fringe
